title: Build Week 6: Cogram Agent, Webex, Procore Integrations, and Global Search
summary: Between September 15 and October 17, 2025, Cogram released 123 improvements including SharePoint integration for Cogram Agent, Webex meeting minutes support, Procore RFI and Submittal sync, and unified global search.
body_markdown:
## Overview


Between September 15 and October 17, 2025, we released 123 improvements to help architects, engineers, and builders improve project documentation and cut admin workloads.


## Cogram Agent for AEC: SharePoint Integration and Firm-Level Control


### What's New


- **SharePoint integration:** Users could search their Microsoft 365 tenant and work with files directly from the product.
- **Organizational controls:** Firms could set product behaviors for tone, templates, and best practices.


This release called the product the AI Assistant. It is now[Cogram Agent](https://cogram.com/agent) . For current setup and supported connected-data workflows, see the[Cogram Agent guide](https://docs.cogram.com/guides/agent) .


### Example Prompts


- "Find the latest structural sketch in SharePoint for Project (ID: ...) and summarize open questions from yesterday's meeting."


## Meeting Minutes for Webex


This release expanded automatic meeting minutes support to include Webex, alongside Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Google Meet. For the current Microsoft Teams connection process, see[Connect Cogram to Microsoft Teams](https://docs.cogram.com/guides/microsoft-teams) .


## Procore Integration: RFIs & Submittals


This release added synchronization of RFIs and Submittals between Procore and Cogram, including status tracking and access to related file attachments. For current connection requirements and setup, see[Connect Cogram to Procore](https://docs.cogram.com/guides/connecting-procore) .


## Global Search (Ctrl+K)


A unified search function allowing users to find projects, meetings, reports, observations, and emails from a single interface.


## Project Management & Core UX Improvements


- Admin dashboard for project management
- Smarter member suggestions when adding project teams
- Drawings embedded in Site Reports with Reports as first-class navigation items
- Consistent filters and delete patterns across meetings, emails, and reports
- Cogram Agent UI refinements for improved readability
